scope: Controller D1 software settlement only; Hardware Unverified and no Stage 1 refreeze

acquire.deadline_clock: absolute target_ns in the owning Runtime Clock epoch
acquire.abandoned_future: an unresolved record cannot grant; an unobserved granted lease falls back to the same generation cleanup

actions.effect_boundary: Succeeded only when the backend settlement gate consumes the physical final-byte completion for the complete logical report
actions.backend_final_byte: ordinary direct, Automation direct, and the effect-completing final precise-sequence report bind one Operation settlement owner to the backend gate; the unique physical completion owner reserves FullAccepted before Clock, telemetry, or hook work, so late cancellation or close cannot take the owner; reservation rejection fails closed and duplicate completion cannot fabricate FullAccepted
actions.intermediate_sequence: an accepted non-final precise-sequence report is not whole-operation success; cancellation or failure before final acceptance settles its neutral and stream before the operation terminal
actions.sealed_action: release seals admission, cancels uneffected admitted actions, settles each action, then dispatches one neutral
actions.partial_io: a partial logical write that cannot complete closes the stream before action or release settlement

release.failure: Err(cleanup_failure) only after a legitimate owner has proved completion and stream settlement; missing owner/evidence is ownership loss rather than release failure
release.pacing: neutral target is max(Runtime Clock now, last accepted report plus minimum interval)
release.close_after_settlement: a close that acquires a record before backend final-byte reservation consumes its same neutral; GateClaimed or retained Committed lane-owned records cannot consume a later resource close, which dispatches one independent paced final neutral

proven_owner.precondition: a legitimate Controller lane owner consumed the completion and proved stream settlement before later cleanup failure
proven_owner.waiter: every affected action and release waiter completes exactly once with the same Err(cleanup_failure)
proven_owner.close: the Controller permanently seals admission, preserves the first failure, and Runtime close reports CloseFailed after required join

ownership_loss.precondition: Controller lane ownership is lost and no transferable owner, completion, or stream-settlement evidence is provable
ownership_loss.waiter: the affected action and release waiter stay nonterminal and are not woken
ownership_loss.close: the record and registry identity remain for diagnosis and Runtime close reports CloseFailed

close.waiters: close seals acquire and action admission, settles acquire/action/release waiters including records registered after close seal, then joins the lane

serial.completion_owner: the unique Windows completion owner reserves and publishes final-byte settlement before returning a full count to the Controller lane

obligation_matrix.expect: a cancelled acquire resolves Cancelled before lane grant
an absolute Runtime-clock acquire deadline settles without lane progress
busy admission projects Failure without granting another lease
Cancelled, Deadline, Closed, and Failure retain the specified same-observation priority
a dropped unresolved acquire cannot later grant a lease
successive lease generations are non-zero and never reused
a lease from another Controller cannot authorize an action
a sealed generation rejects stale action admission before submission
release interrupts an uneffected in-flight generation action before neutral acceptance
a sealed future action settles without waiting for its former target
Drop seals a lease and starts its one neutral cleanup before another grant
the release neutral does not dispatch before the shared pacing target
a fully accepted neutral settles its release waiter as NeutralAccepted
partial automation I/O settles the stream before release reports not-delivered
one typed cleanup failure projects identically to action and sealed release waiters
a typed final checked-close failure overrides a pending report's close cancellation and projects the same Runtime close failure
a proven connect-recovery checked-close error or panic overrides an already registered cancellation and permanently seals admission
a proven action cleanup failure overrides a registered cancellation for the action, sealed release, Controller admission, and Runtime close
a strict cleanup failure arriving while FullAccepted claim is in flight finishes that same claimed Runtime transaction as Failed
close settles pending acquire, action, and release waiters before joining the lane
completion and close intent share one release-record transition lock before the backend gate
a release whose backend FullAccepted precedes close remains gate-owned and close dispatches one independent paced final neutral
a release registered after close seal settles only after the stream is closed
close interrupts an unaccepted neutral and settles its existing record without retry
backend final-byte acceptance wins over a late close cancellation request
CancelIoEx ERROR_NOT_FOUND still consumes a full overlapped completion
fake and system-serial adapters agree on reusable and partial write settlement
ownership loss preserves a nonterminal record and reports close failure without a false wake
a lane panic after physical FullAccepted preserves the already claimed report success while Runtime close records lane ownership loss
ordinary direct final-byte acceptance claims Succeeded before a registered or late cancellation can rewrite it
the final precise-sequence report claims whole-operation Succeeded before a registered or late cancellation can rewrite it
an accepted intermediate precise-sequence report remains nonterminal; cancellation before final acceptance neutralizes and releases before Cancelled
a final precise-sequence partial or failed report never succeeds and settles the stream before terminal observation
a retained lane-owned Committed record cannot consume a later close; close dispatches one independent paced final neutral
an older retained settlement cannot short-circuit close transition of a later GateClaimed release record
a drop-started GateClaimed release remains gate-owned and close runs exactly one independent final neutral
close transitions every retained release record before aggregating whether an existing neutral was consumed
the backend physical final-byte completion reserves the report owner before cancel or close can take it, then deferred publication commits the accepted action
a release physical final-byte reservation precedes close ownership, so close after reservation sends one independent paced final neutral
a rejected final-byte reservation cannot be upgraded by a sequential or concurrent duplicate completion
